items.name: Mansion House
items.label: E Mansion House
items.note: Bank junction, on the Mansion House corner. Leads to the ticket hall under the junction.

items.name: Walbrook
items.label: F Walbrook
items.note: Walbrook, at the Bank junction end. Leads to the west end of the Central line platforms.

items.name: Queen Victoria Street and Poultry
items.label: G Queen Victoria St
items.note: Where Queen Victoria Street meets Poultry. Leads to the west end of the Central line platforms.

items.name: Poultry
items.label: H Poultry
items.note: Poultry, at Bank junction. Leads to the ticket hall under the junction.

items.name: Princes Street and Threadneedle Street
items.label: J Bank of England
items.note: On the corner of Princes Street and Threadneedle Street, by the Bank of England. Leads to the ticket hall under the junction.

items.name: Threadneedle Street
items.label: K Threadneedle St
items.note: Threadneedle Street, east of the junction towards the Royal Exchange. Leads to the ticket hall under the junction.

items.name: Cornhill
items.label: L Cornhill
items.note: Cornhill, east of the junction along the Royal Exchange. Leads to the ticket hall under the junction.

items.name: Cornhill and Lombard Street
items.label: M Lombard St
items.note: Between Cornhill and Lombard Street at Bank junction. Leads to the ticket hall under the junction.

items.name: Lombard Street and King William Street
items.label: N Lombard St
items.note: On the corner of Lombard Street and King William Street. Leads to the Northern line and DLR ticket hall.

items.name: King William Street
items.label: P King William St
items.note: King William Street. Leads to the Northern line and DLR ticket hall.

items.name: King William Street lift
items.label: R KWS lift
items.stepFreeNote: Step-free to the DLR only. The street lift works on request: press the button to call staff.
items.note: Street lift on King William Street down to the Northern line and DLR ticket hall, then lifts on to the DLR.

items.name: Walbrook (Bloomberg building)
items.label: S Bloomberg
items.stepFreeNote: Step-free to the Waterloo & City line, Monday to Friday.
items.note: Entrance on Walbrook in the Bloomberg building, opened November 2018, with two lifts down to the Waterloo & City line.

items.name: Cannon Street
items.label: T Cannon St
items.stepFreeNote: Step-free to the Northern line and the DLR.
items.note: Ticket hall at street level on the corner of Cannon Street and Nicholas Lane, opened 27 February 2023. Six escalators and two lifts go down to the Northern line and DLR.

items.name: Fish Street Hill (Monument)
items.label: A Fish Street Hill
items.note: Monument station's Fish Street Hill entrance, near the Monument itself. Leads to the District and Circle line ticket hall.

items.name: King William Street (Monument)
items.label: B King William St
items.note: Monument station's King William Street entrance. Leads to the District and Circle line ticket hall.

items.name: Cannon Street (Monument)
items.label: C Cannon St
items.note: Monument station's Cannon Street entrance, by passage to the District and Circle line ticket hall.

items.name: Gracechurch Street (Monument)
items.label: D Gracechurch St
items.note: Monument station's Gracechurch Street entrance, by passage to the District and Circle line ticket hall.

items.name: Ticket hall under Bank junction
items.label: Junction ticket hall
items.note: The round ticket hall under the road junction, reached from entrances E, H, J, K, L and M. Escalators go down to the Central line.

items.name: Northern line and DLR ticket hall (King William Street)
items.label: KWS ticket hall
items.stepFreeNote: Step-free to the DLR only, through entrance R and its lifts.
items.note: Reached from entrances N, P and R on King William Street and Lombard Street.

items.name: Cannon Street ticket hall
items.label: Cannon St ticket hall
items.stepFreeNote: Lifts to the Northern line and DLR.
items.note: Opened 27 February 2023 at street level on Cannon Street. Entrance T.

items.name: Bloomberg entrance (Walbrook)
items.label: Walbrook lift hall
items.note: Small entrance hall between the Walbrook street lift and the lift down to the Waterloo & City line.

items.name: Monument ticket hall
items.label: Monument ticket hall
items.note: Ticket hall for the District and Circle lines, from entrances A, B, C and D. Stairs go down to the platforms.

items.name: Central line, platforms 5 and 6
items.label: Central line
items.note: About 20.7 m below the street. Platform 5 westbound, platform 6 eastbound. No step-free access.

items.name: Waterloo & City line, platforms 7 and 8
items.label: Waterloo & City
items.stepFreeNote: Step-free from the Walbrook entrance (S), Monday to Friday. Boarding is by manual ramp.
items.note: Trains from both platforms run non-stop to Waterloo.

items.name: Northern line, platforms 3 and 4
items.label: Northern line
items.stepFreeNote: Step-free from the Cannon Street entrance (T). Level-access boarding points, and staff can lay a mini ramp.
items.note: About 30.5 m below the street. Platform 3 (southbound) is in the tunnel opened on 15 May 2022; the old southbound platform is now a concourse. Platform 4 is northbound.

items.name: DLR, platforms 9 and 10
items.label: DLR
items.stepFreeNote: Step-free from the Cannon Street entrance (T), or from King William Street (R) by the lift on request.
items.note: About 41.4 m below the street, the deepest level in the station.

items.name: District and Circle lines (Monument), platforms 1 and 2
items.label: District & Circle
items.stepFreeNote: No step-free access from the street. Changing between the District and Circle lines in the same direction is step-free: both use the same platform.
items.note: Monument station, about 8.2 m below the street. Platform 1 westbound, platform 2 eastbound.

items.name: Cannon Street escalators
items.label: Cannon St escalators
items.note: Six escalators from the Cannon Street ticket hall down to the Northern line and on to the DLR, opened February 2023.

items.name: Lift G: Cannon Street to Northern line
items.label: Lift G
items.note: Lift from the Cannon Street ticket hall to the Northern line platforms. One of two lifts that gave the Northern line step-free access for the first time in 2023.

items.name: Lift F: Cannon Street, Northern line and DLR
items.label: Lift F
items.note: Lift from the Cannon Street ticket hall that stops at the Northern line and goes on to the DLR, so it also links those two lines step-free.

items.name: Lift A: King William Street street lift
items.label: Lift A
items.note: Street lift from King William Street (entrance R) to the Northern line and DLR ticket hall. It works on request: press the button to call staff.

items.name: Lifts from the King William Street ticket hall
items.label: Ticket hall lifts
items.note: Lifts from the Northern line and DLR ticket hall down to the lower concourse, where lift C continues to the DLR.

items.name: Lift C: concourse to DLR
items.label: Lift C
items.note: Lift from the lower concourse down to the DLR platforms.

items.name: Walbrook lifts to the Waterloo & City line
items.label: Walbrook lifts
items.note: Two lifts, street to entrance hall and entrance hall to the Waterloo & City platforms. They run Monday to Friday.

items.name: Escalators from the King William Street ticket hall
items.label: KWS escalators
items.note: Escalators from the Northern line and DLR ticket hall down to the Northern line concourse.

items.name: Escalators to the Central line
items.label: Central escalators
items.note: Escalators from the ticket hall under Bank junction down to the Central line platforms.

items.name: Northern line to DLR escalators
items.label: Northern–DLR
items.note: Three escalators opened in October 2022 as a direct route between the two lines. TfL said the route cut up to nine minutes off some changes. For a step-free change, use lift F.

items.name: Northern line to Central line moving walkways
items.label: Moving walkways
items.note: Two 100 m moving walkways and three escalators between the Northern and Central lines, opened October 2022. The Central line has no step-free access.

items.name: Waterloo & City line passage
items.label: W&C passage
items.note: Passage from the Waterloo & City platforms into the rest of the station, for the Central line, the junction ticket hall and the Northern line. Not step-free: see the street route for that.

items.name: Step-free change: Waterloo & City to Northern line and DLR
items.label: Street route (290 m)
items.note: The step-free change between the Waterloo & City line and the Northern line or DLR is a 290 m trip: the Walbrook lifts up to the street, along Walbrook and Cannon Street to entrance T, then the Cannon Street lifts. The Walbrook lifts run Monday to Friday.

items.name: Escalators 4 and 5: Northern line to District and Circle
items.label: Escalators 4 & 5 (closed)
items.note: The walking route between the Northern line and Monument's District and Circle platforms. Closed from 20 October 2025 until early 2027 while escalators 4 and 5 are replaced: follow the signs for the other route, which can be via the street. If it takes you out through the gates, touch out and touch back in to pay the right fare.

items.name: Stairs to the District and Circle lines
items.label: Monument stairs
items.note: Stairs from Monument's ticket hall down to the District and Circle line platforms.
